sloka: एवं सीकृतदारो वै लङ्काया ईश्वरः प्रभुः ।गत्वा तु नगरीं भार्ये भ्रातृभ्यां समुपाहरत् ।। ७.१२.२२ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ sīkṛtadāro vai laṅkāyā īśvaraḥ prabhuḥ ।gatvā tu nagarīṁ bhārye bhrātṛbhyāṁ samupāharat ।। 7.12.22 ॥

translations.english: Thus, the mighty lord of Lanka, Ravana, having taken wives for himself, went to the city and presented two wives to his brothers.
